verdict.rationale: Tailscale enables frictionless SSH access between devices (testimonials show users SSH'ing into boxes without extra setup, e.g. tailscale-docs-7, tailscale-docs-17), but this works via Tailscale's identity-based ACL/network-layer auth rather than traditional SSH key-pair generation, and no evidence describes a keypair-generation workflow or 'tailscale ssh' key management feature explicitly. missing for 10: documentation of actual SSH key-pair generation/management, first-party docs on Tailscale SSH feature mechanics, independent confirmation of passwordless key-based access specifically.
